subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding sequences, including arithmetic and geometric sequences
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds physical term-by-term patterns to distinguish constant-difference (arithmetic) from constant-ratio (geometric) sequences
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a sequence pattern to its correct classification and next term
exercise.abstract: Student writes the general formula for a given arithmetic or geometric sequence

misconception_flags: confuses arithmetic (adding a constant) with geometric (multiplying by a constant) sequence rules
